entities.name: Marcus Högberg
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marcus Högberg is a Swedish professional ice hockey goaltender for the Bridgeport Islanders of the American Hockey League (AHL) while under contract to the New York Islanders of the National Hockey League (NHL). Högberg was selected by the Ottawa Senators in the third round of the 2013 NHL entry draft.
